title: infrastructure-weekly-update-2026-07-27
content:
Infra weekly update — 2026-07-27
Owner: Priya Patel (infra lead)
Collaborators: Alex Chen, Miguel Ramirez, Samantha Lee, Jordan Kim
Drive area: shared_drives/engineering/infrastructure
Status: Draft (for review with SRE and serving-runtime leads)

1) Executive summary
- Fleet overall utilization remains elevated as we onboard a new EU enterprise customer. Average GPU utilization (7-day rolling) = 68%. Peak sustained utilization in eu-west-1 reached 94% during a busy window on 2026-07-22 causing request queueing and brief throttling.
- Current fleet: ~320 GPUs total (mix of A100-40GB and H100-80GB). Dedicated reservations: 120 GPUs across customers. Free/elastic capacity available for hosted API is lower than target in EU region (target headroom 25%, current ~12%).
- Immediate ask: approve temporary allocation of additional H100 capacity in eu-west-1 (target +24 GPUs) while we finish cluster rebalancing next week.

2) Fleet & capacity details
- Fleet composition (approx): A100-40GB: 160 GPUs; H100-80GB: 140 GPUs; L4: 20 GPUs (edge tests).
- Region breakdown (approx active GPUs):
  - us-west-2: 110 (util 62%)
  - us-east-1: 80 (util 59%)
  - eu-west-1: 80 (util 86% peak, 72% avg)
  - ap-southeast-1: 50 (util 48%)
- Dedicated vs hosted split: Dedicated reserved: 120 GPUs (mostly A100); Hosted pool for customers and burst: 200 GPUs.
- Autoscaling updates: We tuned the burst policy on 2026-07-20 to reduce scale-up oscillation. Scale-up cooldown increased from 30s -> 90s for seq-length >1024 workloads. Observed fewer hot start churn events since change.

3) Incidents & oncall highlights
- 2026-07-22 14:18 UTC: eu-west-1 throttling incident (INC-2026-0722-01) — root cause: sudden increase in long-sequence generative jobs from a new enterprise customer + a routing misconfiguration that sent traffic to a partially-full H100 cluster undergoing maintenance. Impact: increased 429s and request queueing for ~22 minutes. Mitigation: rollback of routing change + temporary capacity increase (manual reassign of two dedicated nodes). Post-mortem in progress (JIRA INF-1278).
- No data loss. Latency SLO for streaming endpoints missed p95 during the window.
- Action: require canary validation window on routing changes for eu-west-1 (owner: Jordan Kim).

4) Performance & metrics
- 7-day rolling p95 token latency (hosted API, mixed models): 480ms (target 400ms). Degradation mainly correlated with eu-west-1 peak.
- Queue backlog: peaked at ~2.3k queued requests during incident window; normal baseline ~200–400.
- Token throughput: hosted-prod aggregate tokens/s ~1.8M (avg), down 8% week-over-week due to capacity pressure and increased heavy-generation loads.
- Cost note: H100 spot/ephemeral instances helped absorb some burst traffic, but spot interruption rates increased in us-east-1 last week — raising small cost/reliability tradeoffs.

5) Projects & work in progress
- Q3 capacity plan (INF-1245): finalizing purchase order for +96 H100s across US and EU; procurement timeline: PO submitted 2026-07-25, expected delivery/bring-up in waves starting 2026-08-10. Action: Miguel to own node provisioning runbook.
- Rolling upgrade: start migrating some A100 pools to H100 for high-memory models. Planned maintenance window: 2026-07-30 -> 2026-08-03 (low-traffic windows nightly). Expect short-lived capacity dips; will coordinate with product for canary traffic shifts.
- Autoscaler v2 alpha: internal PR merged (https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/342) — testing staged deployment in staging cluster. Feature: workload-aware batching signals + predictive scale-up for long-seq jobs.
- KV prefix cache improvements: experiments show 12% token cost savings for repeat-prompt customers — rolling to prod for top-10 customers next week.

6) Region-specific notes
- eu-west-1: Highest pressure; short-term mitigation = temporary H100 allocation + gating new heavy-generation capacity for new customers until additional H100s are online.
- ap-southeast-1: capacity healthy, but monitoring shows increased latency for small-batch embedding jobs — investigating network bandwidth shaping.
- us-west-2/us-east-1: normal, but us-east spot interruptions need guardrails (fallback to on-demand pools for critical customers).

7) Capacity requests & approvals needed
- Emergency allocation: +24 H100s in eu-west-1 for 3 weeks (reason: new enterprise onboarding spike). Owner: Priya. Cost estimate: ~$75k/week incremental (ballpark).
- Approve overtime for provisioning team next two weekends (2026-08-01 & 2026-08-08) to accelerate bring-up of purchased H100s.

8) Risks & blockers
- PO lead time risk: vendor lead times could slip; need contingency to convert some dedicated A100 reservations to hosted burst capacity if shipments delay.
- Routing/change management: one-off routing misconfig caused incident — require change freeze for region routing during provisioning windows and add canary validation (Jordan).
- Oncall fatigue: multiple paging events in last 3 weeks; propose temporary rotation bump and extra SRE support during EU onboarding ramp.

9) Action items (owners)
- Miguel Ramirez: finalize provisioning runbook + automation scripts for new H100 nodes (due 2026-07-30).
- Jordan Kim: add canary validation step to routing change playbook and run a dry-run before next maintenance (due 2026-07-29).
- Alex Chen: prepare brief for sales/CS to delay further EU heavy workload onboarding until capacity targets met (due 2026-07-28).
- Samantha Lee: complete post-mortem draft for INC-2026-0722-01 (linked JIRA INF-1278) and distribute to infra + SRE (due 2026-07-29).

10) Notes for product & CS
- CS: we will accept the EU customer ramp but need staged ramping (20% increments) while we add capacity — align on timeline.
- Product: recommend temporary UI quota reductions for long-sequence generation in eu-west-1 to protect latency for other tenants.

11) Meeting cadence / next steps
- Infra weekly sync: Wednesday 10:30am PT — will include dedicated provisioning checkpoint this week.
- Emergency capacity review with finance & procurement: Friday 2:00pm PT 2026-07-30.

-- end of update --
